verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is a marketing line saying a Bot "makes the custom assets according to your creative direction" via an art pipeline. One community user reports a 'prototyper' bot that generated a pattern from their logo and delivered it as a .ai file, which hints at prompt-driven creation and derivation of visual assets. missing for 10: documented native text-to-image generation, documented image editing from natural-language prompts, detail on supported formats or tools, and hands-on corroboration beyond a single anecdote.
